name: New Era Cap Company (New Era Cap Co., LLC)
note: Buffalo, New York headwear company controlled by its founding Koch family and led by fourth-generation family member Chris Koch (Reuters, 2023-09-07; SGB Media, 2023-09-09). Not related to Koch Industries of Kansas. In August 2022 ACON Investments closed a ~$700 million continuation round under which the NFL, NBA and MLB became minority investors (Front Office Sports, 2022-08-07).
